belief.label: The Belief
belief.heading:
How we think 
about Capitar
belief.description: A good doctor will refer you to another specialist if that is genuinely better for you. We hold ourselves to the same standard. If debt is not the right answer for your business, we will say so, even when it costs us the deal.

items.title: Independent credit assessment.
items.description: We evaluate and underwrite every credit ourselves, going deep into the business to understand its building blocks from the ground up.

people.label: The people
people.heading:
The people you'll
work with
people.description: Over 100 years of combined experience in underwriting and structuring credit. Behind that number are the people you will speak to directly.
people.biography: Years spent across the capital markets, venture and operating world have shaped how we think about what founders actually need from capital.

quote.label: The Capitar view
quote.statement: Founders deserve a credit partner who understands where the business is going, not only where it stands today.
